newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AT&T launches new Internet transaction tool.
newsitem.headline: AT&T launches new Internet transaction tool.

text.p: U.S. telecommunications giant AT&T launched on Tuesday a new service, AT&T InterCommerce, that allows companies with different information systems to conduct business transactions over the Internet.
AT&T said AT&T InterCommerce, which was developed in Australia, would allow groups to conduct Internet transactions without investing heavily in new software and hardware.
It said AT&T InterCommerce had built-in translation capabilities and manages business transactions so that senders knew their information would be delivered in the formats the recipients preferred.
AT&T said the new service supports many industry standards for electronic commerce, as well as company proprietary standards.
It said AT&T InterCommerce was offered in Australia by AT&T EasyLink Services Australia.

AT&T EasyLink Services is a joint venture which is 51 percent owned by AT&T, 34 percent owned by CSC Continuum, a unit of Computer Sciences Corp and 15 percent by Qantas Airways Ltd unit Qantas Information Technology.
